Write src/pages/Expenses.jsx. State: expenses (from mockExpenses), showModal (false), editingExpense (null), filterMonth (current month YYYY-MM format), searchQuery, page. Monthly stat cards (4): Total This Month, Rent+Utilities, Salaries, Other. Filter expenses by filterMonth (match created_at YYYY-MM). Table columns: Date, Category Badge (Rent=info/Salaries=warn/Utilities=info/Repairs=warn/Other=info), Description, Amount N, Recorded By, Actions (Edit/Delete for admin/manager). Month selector input (type=month). Add/Edit Expense Modal (size='sm'): date (required, default today), category select (Rent/Salaries/Utilities/Repairs/Advertising/Transport/Stationery/Other), description (required), amount (number required). Save: push to mockExpenses or update. Delete: confirm then remove. Admin/Manager only -- Cashier redirect to /dashboard via ProtectedRoute.

Write src/pages/Reports.jsx. State: activeTab ('sales'), dateFrom (first day of current month), dateTo (today), exportLoading (false). Admin/Manager only via ProtectedRoute. Tab bar: Sales Summary | Inventory Report | Profit & Loss. Sales Summary tab: date range inputs (from/to), compute filtered sales from mockSales, show: Total Sales N stat card, Total Transactions stat card, Average Sale N stat card. Best-selling products table: group mockSaleItems by product_name, sum quantities, sort desc, show top 10 with rank, product, total_qty, total_revenue columns. Sales by payment method: small bar chart (Recharts BarChart) with Cash/Transfer/Credit bars. Export button downloads filtered sales as xlsx. Inventory Report tab: table of all products with columns: SKU, Name, Category, Unit, Qty in Stock, Cost Price N, Selling Price N, Stock Value N (qty*cost_price), Potential Revenue N (qty*selling_price). Footer row with totals. Total Stock Value stat card at top. Export button. P&L tab: date range inputs. Compute: Total Revenue = sum of non-voided mockSales in date range; Total Expenses = sum of mockExpenses in date range by date field; Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Goods (sum of sale_items qty*cost_price from mockProducts); Net Profit = Revenue - Total Expenses. Four large stat cards. Expense breakdown table by category. Simple Recharts LineChart of daily revenue vs expenses over the period.

Write src/pages/Settings.jsx. State: activeTab ('general'), settings (copy of mockSettings), users (mockUsers), showRoleModal (false), editingUser (null), savingGeneral (false). Admin only via ProtectedRoute. Tab bar: General | Users | System (System only shown in mock mode). General tab: form with shop_name, shop_address, shop_phone, receipt_footer text fields. Save button updates mockSettings (or Supabase settings table). Users tab (admin only, hidden from manager even if they somehow reach this page): table of mockUsers with columns Name, Email, Role Badge. Edit Role button opens modal with role select (admin/manager/cashier), save updates mockUsers. System tab (mock mode only): 'Clear Session Data' button (resets posStore), 'View Mock Data Info' section showing counts (mockProducts.length etc.) as read-only stat cards for debugging.
